title: Stock Market ETL
desc: Streams live stock data from the Alpha Vantage API through a Kafka pipeline, applies transformations with Pandas, and persists results to both AstraDB and AWS S3. Built to handle continuous ingestion without data loss under high-volume market conditions.

title: Data Generator
desc: Generates large sets of typed mock data — emails, passwords, IDs, and more — for rapid prototyping and testing. Also parses uploaded .env files to produce type-safe environment variable modules.

title: Pathfinder
desc: Visualizes classic pathfinding algorithms — Dijkstra, A*, BFS, DFS — navigating randomly generated mazes in real time. Highlights visited cells and traces the optimal route from start to finish.

title: Sort Visualizer
desc: Animates popular sorting algorithms — Bubble, Merge, Quick, and more — as a live bar chart. Lets you adjust array size and speed to see how each algorithm behaves at different scales.

title: Portfolio
desc: This site — an anime/RPG-themed portfolio built with Next.js and Three.js. Features a VRM character, glitch animations, a terminal easter egg, and a Konami code secret.
